description: Office of the Governor - Uva Province - Mr. Anura Raveendra Vidanagamage Appointed as Acting Minister of Road Development, Housing, Wator Supply, Estate Infrastructure and Co-operative affairs etc. Mr. B. Saliya Sumeda De Silva appointed as Chief Minister and Minister of Finance and Planning Law and Peace, Education, Local Government Power and Energy etc.
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Hon. Anura Raveendra Vidanagamage, Hon. Akalan Sendil Thondaman Mutthuvinayagam, Hon. Balage Saliya Sumeda De Silva, Hon. Chamara Sampath Dassanayake) AND detailed portfolio responsibilities (e.g., "Minister of Health, Indigenous Medicine, Probation & Child Care, Women's Affairs and Social Welfare," "Acting Minister of Road Development, Housing, Water Supply, Estate Infrastructure and Co-operative Affairs, Tamil Education," etc.). The content clearly outlines both "who" is being appointed and "what" specific areas they are responsible for, meeting the criteria for Hybrid Gazette classification.
